answer: The echo schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the signal checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 14 effective identities must lock that capital for 24 epochs and keep it locked through every meadow audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 24 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 34 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
